replacements.old: local alt_config_file data_root log_level iptables ip6tables bip
replacements.new: local alt_config_file data_root log_level iptables ip6tables bip firewall_backend dns_fallback

config_get_bool ip6tables globals ip6tables "0"
	config_get firewall_backend globals firewall_backend ""

config_get storage_driver globals storage_driver ""

	if [ "${firewall_backend}" = "nftables" ]; then
		. /usr/libexec/m28c-docker.sh
		m28c_docker_validate_policy || return 1
		[ -n "${dns}" ] || dns_fallback=$(m28c_docker_default_dns "${bip}")
	fi

[ -z "${dns}" ] || json_close_array
	if [ -n "${dns_fallback}" ]; then
		json_add_array "dns"
		json_add_string "" "${dns_fallback}"
		json_close_array
	fi

# Native nftables uses the explicit default bridge policies in fw4.
	if [ "${iptables}" -eq "1" ] && [ "${firewall_backend}" != "nftables" ]; then
		config_foreach iptables_add_blocking_rule firewall
	fi
	return 0

m28c_docker_finish_defaults() {
	local defaults=/etc/uci-defaults/90-m28c-docker-nftables
	[ -f "$defaults" ] || return 0
	/bin/sh "$defaults" --after-mounts || return 1
	# Load the WAN guard before any retained containers can restart.
	# This runs once after fstab; ordinary starts do not reload firewall4.
	fw4 check && fw4 reload || return 1
	rm -f "$defaults" || return 1
}

boot() {
	m28c_docker_finish_defaults || return $?
	uciadd

local nofile=$(cat /proc/sys/fs/nr_open)

	m28c_docker_finish_defaults || return $?
	process_config || return $?

replacements.old:
# Docker doesn't work well out of the box with fw4. This is because Docker relies on a compatibility layer that
# naively translates iptables rules. For the best compatibility replace the following dependencies:
# `firewall4` -> `firewall`
# `iptables-nft` -> `iptables-zz-legacy`
# `ip6tables-nft` -> `ip6tables-zz-legacy`

# Docker undermines the fw3 rules. By default all external source IPs are allowed to connect to the Docker host.
# See https://docs.docker.com/network/iptables/ for more details.

# firewall config changes are only additive i.e firewall will need to be restarted first to clear old changes,
# then docker restarted to load in new changes.
replacements.new:
# Docker 29 native nftables uses firewall4 policy for the default docker0 bridge.
# WAN blocking, outbound forwarding and LAN published ports are installed once.
# Adjust these policies in firewall4; custom legacy extra_iptables_args and
# blocked interfaces other than wan are rejected until explicitly migrated.
# An explicit globals.dns list is preserved; otherwise use the router DNS.
